stories.headline: Pakistan says Mecca defence pact members will discuss political engagement with Houthis
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan would hold an emergency meeting in Riyadh to discuss Iran's suggestion of political engagement with Yemen's Houthis amid regional escalation.
stories.why_it_matters: The development tests the new trilateral defence framework and Pakistan's diplomatic role in Middle East security.

sources.title: Pakistan says Mecca pact members to hold emergency talks on engaging Houthis

stories.headline: IMF praises Pakistan's oil-crisis handling and urges gas-sector reforms
stories.summary: The IMF praised Pakistan's handling of the oil crisis while pressing for faster work on targeted gas subsidies and reforms addressing gas-sector circular debt reported at Rs3.6 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: Energy-sector reform and circular debt remain central to Pakistan's macroeconomic programme and fiscal sustainability.

sources.title: IMF praises oil crisis handling, urges gas sector reforms

stories.headline: Taiwan receives first new F-16V Block 70 fighters from 66-aircraft order
stories.summary: The first two aircraft from Taiwan's order of 66 new F-16V Block 70 fighters arrived, strengthening its air-defence capability amid tensions with China.
stories.why_it_matters: The delivery is significant to cross-Strait deterrence and US-Taiwan defence relations.

sources.title: Taiwan's first new F-16V fighter jets arrive to bolster defences against China
